name: Annie Khalid
description: '''Noor-ul-Ain Khalid''' ({{Langx|ur|نور العین خالد}}; born 27 March 1987), known professionally as '''Annie Khalid''' ({{Lang|ur|عینی خالد|rtl=yes}}), is a Pakistani-born British singer and model. She rose to fame in [[Pakistan]] in 2006, after releasing the single "Mahiya"; the song was used in the 2007 film ''[[Awarapan]]'' in [[India]] and became the most-played Pakistani song of 2005, 2006 and 2007.
